description:
Project Overview

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU) offers a PhD position on the physics of synthetic molecular motors within the international consortium "Joining Forces for Human-Made Molecular Machines." The position is hosted by the Department of Physics and Astronomy at VU Amsterdam and is one of nine PhD/PD positions funded by the NWO-XL consortium led by principal investigator Iddo Heller.

Research position overview

In this PhD project, you will investigate the physics of light-driven synthetic molecular motors and of the transport machines built from them, using advanced single-molecule techniques. Molecular motors are intriguing nanomachines that convert fuel to useful work and directed motion.

Research Areas

  • Synthetic molecular motors driven by light
  • Transport machines built from molecular motors
  • Advanced single-molecule techniques
  • Molecular machine physics
  • Nanoscale motion and work conversion
